baseline_models.mechanism: The wished-for thing is specified at one pole and delegated labor realizes it at the other, forming an authorization-to-production chain.

activation_trace.role: Putting another to work and requesting labor supplies the executing link that turns specification into output.
Will attached to bringing about or attaining a thing supplies the specifying and initiating link.

changed_reading.before: They make whatever the beneficiary wants.
changed_reading.after: The clause maps how authorized will becomes determinate material output through delegated work.

baseline_models.mechanism: Food vessels scaled by reservoirs and cooking pots made stationary describe durable, high-throughput provisioning rather than isolated luxury utensils.

activation_trace.role: The food-platter branch supplies the direct feeding function of the large vessels.
The gathered-water basin supplies the comparison's reservoir scale and collective capacity.
The cooking-pot branch supplies transformation of provision by sustained preparation.
Fixity and firm establishment turn the vessels into installed infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: The verse inventories magnificent bowls and cauldrons.
changed_reading.after: The vessels form a stationary provisioning plant able to gather, cook, and distribute at communal scale.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: اعْمَلُوا آلَ دَاوُودَ شُكْرًا وَقَلِيلٌ مِنْ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُورُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative makes gratitude an intended practice whose effect must appear in service; the closing scarcity diagnoses how rarely that productive response is realized.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies gratitude's enacted rather than merely verbal mode.
Recognition and visible acknowledgment of benefaction supply the aim of the commanded work.
A little input showing a marked effect makes grateful service legible by yield, not volume alone.
Numerical scarcity marks realized gratitude as an uncommon human capacity.
Humble obedient service locates gratitude within the servant's lived posture.

changed_reading.before: The household is told to say thanks for its gifts.
changed_reading.after: The household must convert received capacity into visible, intentional service, a conversion achieved by few.

baseline_models.mechanism: The vocative recruits a house, its dependents, and its successors as a continuing body that holds and performs an office of grateful work.

activation_trace.role: Those who return to a man and to whom he returns supply household, dependents, and followers as the corporate addressee.
Undertaking and administering an office supplies the household's stewardship function.
Holding responsibility for assigned work turns lineage into an accountable institution.

changed_reading.before: The family of David receives a collective exhortation.
changed_reading.after: Belonging to David's house is enacted as succession in a governed office of grateful production.

baseline_models.mechanism: A fabricated likeness can preserve a model before viewers and thereby participate in public memory or exemplarity, not only ornament.

activation_trace.role: The fashioned image supplies the direct representational object.
The exemplar as a lesson or sign supplies a possible mnemonic function for the image.

changed_reading.before: The تماثيل are decorative images among royal works.
changed_reading.after: They may also be durable represented exemplars that organize what a community sees and remembers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding armor command defines good making as calibrated linkage, complete coverage, and fitness; that craft ethic transfers to the focus verse's large installed works.

activation_trace.role: The cooking vessel supplies the focus artifact whose capacity and construction are being reevaluated.
Deliberate measuring and fitting supply the design discipline behind production.
Perforating and joining rings makes measured interconnection materially concrete.
Suitability for purpose supplies the moral and functional criterion for finished work.

structural_cues: 34:11 repeats the work imperative immediately before 34:13 and places it around measured armor-making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement, linked construction, and fit work; I infer that the same craft ethic governs the focus inventory, while a live alternative confines those criteria to armor alone.

changed_reading.before: Scale and splendor are the salient qualities of the focus objects.
changed_reading.after: Their legitimate splendor depends on measured fit, connected construction, and fitness for purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: David's setting makes solid mountains responsive and hard iron pliable, so household work appears within a wider choreography of returning voices and transformable matter.

activation_trace.role: Intentional making supplies the human side of the responsive material system.
The solid elevated mass supplies matter normally resistant to human-scale response.
Returning to a source supplies reciprocal response rather than one-way extraction.
Softness opposing rough hardness supplies material tractability.
Iron's resistant solidity supplies the hard material whose changed condition enables craft.

structural_cues: 34:10 names David and places responsive mountain, bird, and iron immediately before the work sequence of 34:11-13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return and softened hardness; I infer a reciprocal ecology of craft, while the live alternative treats these as separate favors with no general model of making.

changed_reading.before: The household imposes designs upon passive materials.
changed_reading.after: Its grateful making participates in a field where voices return and resistant matter is made responsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Molten material and hidden workers execute a command only by permission, while later even an atom's weight cannot be independently owned; productive authority is therefore delegated and bounded rather than self-grounding.

activation_trace.role: Delegated labor supplies the focus production relation that requires an authority model.
Effective willing supplies the apparent initiating power whose limits context reveals.
Molten copper supplies the material stream converted into works.
Hidden beings supply the otherwise unnamed workforce of the focus opening.
Permission supplies the higher authorization under which the labor system operates.
Binding command supplies governance and the possibility of accountable deviation.
Exact weight supplies the scale at which claims of autonomous power are tested.
The minute dispersed particle supplies the smallest test case for possession.
Possession and disposal rights supply the ownership claim that the context denies to rival powers.

structural_cues: 34:12 immediately supplies the antecedent and governance conditions for يَعْمَلُونَ in 34:13.
34:22 denies independent ownership, partnership, or support at even the smallest material scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission, command, material flow, and denied atom-scale ownership; I infer a distinction between operational control and ultimate title, while an alternative reads the later denial only as unrelated polemic against false gods.

changed_reading.before: Royal will itself seems sufficient to explain the magnificent output.
changed_reading.after: The output manifests delegated operational authority under permission, not autonomous ownership or unlimited sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The labor order can continue after its ruler has lost life because workers misread a decaying support; when that support is consumed, collapse exposes the ignorance beneath apparent continuity.

activation_trace.role: Firm fixity supplies the focus image of durable installed order.
Ongoing delegated work supplies the institutional activity that can outlast informed command.
Loss of life and power removes the actual directing agent while its posture remains.
Consumption as gradual corruption supplies the hidden erosion of the support.
Noisy disordered falling supplies the abrupt visible failure of apparent stability.
Disclosure after concealment supplies the epistemic result of collapse.
What is hidden from sight supplies the workforce's mistaken information environment.

structural_cues: 34:14 directly follows the fixed vessels and labor command with death, continued labor, decay, and collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an apparently standing ruler, hidden decay, laboring workers, and collapse; I infer that focus fixity is institutionally contingent, while an alternative limits the point to the workers' ignorance of the unseen.

changed_reading.before: The stationary pots and continuing workforce display unqualified durability and mastery.
changed_reading.after: Their stability is a maintained achievement resting on knowable supports; apparent continuity can conceal lost authority and advancing decay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reservoir-scale bowls and fixed pots become nodes in a provision network whose water barriers, measured routes, and settlements can sustain circulation or reverse into flood, substitution, and fragmentation.

activation_trace.role: A large basin of gathered water supplies storage capacity at the center of the network.
Fixed installation supplies stable provisioning nodes.
The cooking vessel supplies bounded capacity for transforming distributed provision.
Nourishing sustenance supplies what the material system is meant to circulate.
Running floodwater supplies the destructive reversal of gathered and governed flow.
An embankment holding back floodwater supplies the hidden control structure behind abundance.
One thing replacing another supplies the conversion of productive abundance into degraded yield.
Measured planning supplies calibrated travel intervals as another form of provisioning capacity.
Tearing into separated pieces supplies network failure at the social and spatial level.

structural_cues: 34:15-19 moves from eating provision and gratitude through dam failure to measured settlements and finally torn routes and people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vessels, stored and released flow, measured travel, and fragmentation; I infer one coupled provisioning network, while a live alternative keeps kitchen, irrigation, and travel as separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The bowls and pots are palace-scale signs of abundance.
changed_reading.after: They are infrastructural nodes in a coupled food, water, and mobility system whose benefits depend on maintained relations and can catastrophically reverse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from materially little produce after failed gratitude to the patient-grateful reader of rupture and then to an excepted group; the focus's few become a resilient remainder, not only a disappointing statistic.

activation_trace.role: Scarcity supplies the focus's small number of fully grateful servants.
A little input producing visible effect supplies a positive capacity latent within smallness.
Material paucity supplies the degraded landscape's literal counterpart to the focus's human fewness.
Holding oneself through distress supplies the endurance by which gratitude survives loss.
Acknowledgment after fragmentation supplies gratitude that is not limited to prosperity.
A distinct separated group supplies the social shape of the exceptional remainder.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats قليل and شكور around ecological and social rupture, then marks an excepted group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical smallness, patient gratitude, and an exception group; I infer a resilient-remnant model, while an alternative treats each recurrence as an independent observation.

changed_reading.before: Few servants are grateful, a flat report of rarity.
changed_reading.after: The few are also the small but effect-bearing remainder able to read loss, endure it, and keep gratitude operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: A community can be torn apart and then made into transmitted accounts and signs; against that sequence, fashioned likenesses can serve as externalized public memory of patterns and consequences.

activation_trace.role: The fashioned image supplies the durable representational medium.
The exemplar as lesson supplies the image's possible warning function.
Becoming an account told by people supplies conversion of a vanished society into memory.
Tearing and dispersal supplies the historical rupture that memory preserves.
A visible distinguishing sign supplies the interpretive status of the remembered event.

structural_cues: 34:19 explicitly moves from making a people into accounts and fragments to calling the result signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies images, cautionary accounts, fragments, and signs; I infer that representation can externalize communal memory, while the live alternative leaves the تماثيل as non-didactic decoration.

changed_reading.before: The statues are self-contained products of skilled manufacture.
changed_reading.after: They may participate in a memory system that makes absent persons or broken histories present as exemplars.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later commanders and subordinates exchange blame, yet recompense remains tied to work; the focus's asymmetric production chain is therefore morally legible only when command, compliance, and result remain under audit.

activation_trace.role: Putting others to work supplies the asymmetric labor relation whose moral quality context tests.
Holding office supplies accountable governance rather than mere household prestige.
Lack of power supplies the subordinate party's constrained position.
Self-magnifying superiority supplies the commanding party's distorted authority.
Binding command supplies the causal claim by which subordinates assign blame upward.
A collar that binds the body supplies the end-state of coercive hierarchy.
Corresponding recompense supplies the audit that returns outcomes to action.
Intentional action supplies the final unit of responsibility despite exchanged blame.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stages a dispute between the weakened and the self-exalting and closes by tying recompense to what they worked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later abusive command hierarchy and action-based recompense; I infer an ethical audit of all delegated work, not an identity between Solomon's workforce and that condemned hierarchy. The live alternative treats the scenes as unrelated.

changed_reading.before: Successful output validates the command structure that produced it.
changed_reading.after: Output alone does not validate hierarchy; grateful purpose, authorized command, and each participant's action remain independently accountable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same cluster of will, servants, and q-d-r is placed inside provision that expands or contracts and is renewed through spending; a vessel's capacity is real, but neither its filling nor its continuity is self-generated.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to a thing supplies the focus's effective specification of output.
The pot supplies a bounded material capacity whose filling is at issue.
Expansion and increase supply one direction of provision's variable scale.
Allocated gift supplies the content whose source exceeds the vessel and household.
Will bound to a thing links the allocation clause back to the focus production clause.
Servant relation places variable provision within the same human field as the focus's grateful servants.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the opposite of expansion and exposes capacity limits.
Outgoing expenditure supplies circulation rather than hoarding as the operative response to provision.
A successor taking the place of what departed supplies renewal after outflow.

structural_cues: 34:36 and 34:39 repeat يَشَاءُ and يَقْدِرُ around provision; 34:39 also repeats عِبَادِ and شَيْءٍ from the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence and q-d-r's pot, planning, and constriction branches; I infer a capacity-allocation metaphor, while the live alternative treats the noun and verb senses as rhetorically unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The enormous vessels imply secure and self-evident abundance.
changed_reading.after: They display receiving capacity, while actual provision remains variable and is sustained through grateful outflow and replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, wealth does not bring anyone near, whereas faithful fit work does and receives upper rooms; architectural elevation in the focus is thus subordinated to enacted moral proximity.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work links the focus's built environment to the later criterion of nearness.
Approach to God supplies the non-material proximity denied to wealth and descendants.
Intentional action supplies the means paired with faith rather than possessions.
Fitness and suitability supply the qualifying quality of the work.
The upper chamber supplies architectural elevation as result and image, not the cause of nearness.

structural_cues: 34:37 juxtaposes failed material means of approach, fit work, doubled recompense, and secure upper chambers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus architecture and later ethical nearness with upper rooms; I infer a critique of treating built height as spiritual rank, while an alternative sees only two unrelated architectural settings.

changed_reading.before: Monumental chambers can appear to embody privileged nearness by themselves.
changed_reading.after: Built elevation is an image or consequence of nearness; fit grateful work, not possession of architecture, is the operative approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden agents can perform delegated work yet later become objects of mistaken worship; the focus's closing 'My servants' distinguishes service within an order from worship directed toward an intermediary.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience and worship supply the focus term whose object must be distinguished.
Delegated work supplies a service relation that need not make the worker or manager divine.
Hidden beings supply the delegated workers immediately before the focus.
Worship directed to an alleged intermediary supplies the relation under examination.
True protecting allegiance supplies the angels' redirection of loyalty away from themselves.
Misdirected obedient worship supplies the error that mere hidden agency can invite.
The hidden beings supply the mistaken object of worship in the later scene.

structural_cues: The surah first presents jinn as workers under permission and later presents worship of jinn as a disowned relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same agent category in labor and worship settings; I infer a warning against deifying delegated agency, while a live alternative distinguishes the two groups without cross-reference.

changed_reading.before: Service, labor, and worship can blur into one vertical relation around spectacular power.
changed_reading.after: Delegated service is legitimate only while ultimate worship and protecting allegiance remain directed beyond every intermediary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later refusal to ask people for payment sharpens 'work as gratitude' into a response to gift rather than a bargain that purchases or repays the giver.

activation_trace.role: Wages and worker sustenance supply the transactional possibility against which grateful work is distinguished.
Acknowledgment of benefaction supplies the non-purchase logic of the imperative.
Asking or requesting supplies the denied demand for payment from the audience.
Compensation for work supplies the explicit wage category redirected away from the hearers.

structural_cues: 34:47 repeats أجر around a denial of requested payment and assigns recompense elsewhere.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prophetic no-fee declaration and the focus's gratitude-work; I infer a shared non-mercenary ethical layer, while the alternative keeps the declaration separate. This does not imply that ordinary material workers should go unpaid.

changed_reading.before: The commanded work could sound like repayment that settles a debt for benefits received.
changed_reading.after: Grateful work acknowledges an unpriced gift and cannot purchase, equal, or discharge its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus opens a short path from will through authorized work to attained things; the ending closes access, placing distance and a barrier between people and appetite's object.

activation_trace.role: Will tied to attaining or bringing about a thing supplies the successful focus-side relation to an object.
Organized labor supplies the authorized means by which the focus-side object is reached.
Reaching by extending toward something supplies the access that has become impossible.
Distance opposing nearness supplies the spatialized failure of late access.
A separator placed between two sides supplies the final severing mechanism.
The self's pull toward a desired object supplies appetite without effective authorized means.

structural_cues: The focus links work to what is willed, whereas the surah's close links distance and a barrier to what is desired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a successful will-work-object chain and a failed appetite-access chain; I infer a deliberate reversal between authorized effective will and belated appetite, while an alternative reads the ending only as eschatological deprivation.

changed_reading.before: Whatever is willed appears immediately available to sufficient power and labor.
changed_reading.after: Effective willing depends on rightful authorization, means, and time; appetite alone can end separated from the very thing it seeks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The q-l-l branch meaning a large jar is far from the surface sense 'few,' but it remains anchored in قَلِيل and is reinforced by the verse's huge food vessels and the sh-k-r image of little producing visible effect. Render only as lexical-material resonance, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جِفَانٍ كَالْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَاسِيَاتٍ ... وَقَلِيلٌ مِنْ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُورُ

activation_trace.role: The large-jar branch lets the closing numerical smallness resonate unexpectedly with the verse's oversized containers.
Little nourishment yielding a visible effect supplies the paradox that small count need not mean small capacity.
The large food vessel supplies the concrete container image against which the few servants are reread.

changed_reading.before: Fewness simply means an inadequate number of grateful servants.
changed_reading.after: The few may also be imagined as rare high-capacity vessels in whom a small input of gift becomes conspicuously fruitful.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The link crosses from the m-th-l branch of standing presence to a later command for people to stand in pairs and singly, so it is associative rather than syntactically asserted. It remains anchored in تَمَاثِيل and the precise standing/thinking sequence; prose should present it as a visual foil, not the statues' lexical definition.

activation_trace.role: Standing and appearing present supplies the posture latent beside the fashioned images.
The made likeness supplies the static represented body.
Bodily standing supplies the living counterpart to the fashioned standing form.
Pairing one with one supplies a relational arrangement for living reflection.
Standing alone supplies the complementary individual arrangement.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the capacity that distinguishes living figures from made likenesses.

changed_reading.before: The تماثيل are active craftsmanship resulting in passive standing images.
changed_reading.after: They can serve as a foil for living figures who must stand, relate or separate, and activate reflection rather than merely occupy form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The conflict echo in the h-r-b inventory is branch-distant from مَحَارِيب, and the armor-to-chains comparison spans separate scenes. It remains anchored in the focus root and the surah's repeated organized metalwork; render as a contained political shadow of craft, never as the direct meaning of محاريب.

activation_trace.role: War and enmity supply the distant conflict shadow carried by the architectural root inventory.
Organized delegated labor supplies the production capacity that can be morally directed in different ways.
Wide complete covering supplies protective armor as one output of disciplined craft.
The binding collar supplies coercive metalwork as the opposed political output.

changed_reading.before: The monumental workshop is morally characterized by technical magnificence alone.
changed_reading.after: Its production capacity carries a contained double potential: measured craft can cover and protect, while corrupted hierarchy can use material skill to bind.

strongest_changes: The focus inventory becomes calibrated craft whose legitimacy rests on fit, linkage, and moral purpose rather than scale alone.
Reservoir bowls and fixed pots expand into a coupled provisioning network vulnerable to failed water control, broken routes, and social fragmentation.
The next ayah turns apparent stability into a contingent achievement that can conceal dead authority, hidden decay, and uninformed labor.
Repeated will, q-d-r, provision, and spending separate receiving capacity from self-generated abundance.
The surah's ending reverses the focus's effective will-work-object chain into appetite blocked from its object.
summary.what_was_special: The trace repeatedly converts spectacular objects into relations: between will and permission, vessel and flow, command and accountability, household and succession, and small number and high visible yield.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly the q-d-r recurrence licenses a deliberate pot, measure, and constriction resonance rather than a reader-built polysemy.
Whether the تماثيل carry mnemonic or exemplary force in this verse, or only become such through the later accounts-and-signs sequence.
How far the later blame dialogue should audit the focus labor hierarchy without assimilating legitimate delegated work to abusive command.
Whether the few-as-large-vessels and living-versus-fashioned-standing outliers are rhetorically active or only branch-supported exploratory echoes.
